title: Handyman Saitou in Another World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Saitou, an undervalued Japanese handyman, is fired, hit by a truck and lands in a fantasy world. He joins an adventuring party of the warrior Raelza, the forgetful old mage Morlock and the coin-hungry fairy cleric Lafanpan, and his lock-picking, repairs and reminders make him indispensable. The series is told in very short episodic chapters that also follow other adventurers in the kingdom.
life_message: Ordinary, practical skills have real worth, and being valued by friends gives life meaning.

content.note: Dungeon fights with monsters; Raelza is the party's fighter (Wikipedia); detail not described in review (to verify).
Labyrinth adventures and a defeated demon king; tone described as warm (Siliconera).

Raelza's crush, Morlock woos women, a bisexual thief, a blood-fetish cleric (Wikipedia); MangaDex suggestive. MangaUpdates lists Child Rape and Forced Pregnancy categories with zero votes, unconfirmed, capped (to verify).
Saitou's insecurity and feeling unappreciated; Morlock's curse-induced memory loss (Wikipedia).

folkways.japan: Reflects the Japanese salaryman theme of being undervalued at work, transplanted into isekai fantasy.

delivery.evidence: Siliconera describes short warm stories showing Saitou's improved self-worth; no review calls it preachy (to verify).
delivery.note: The value of humble work is shown through small episodes rather than stated speeches, per the summaries opened.

winners_losers: Saitou and his misfit party win respect and friendship; the ungrateful boss of his old life is the implied loser; sympathy goes to overlooked workers.
